name: Landhaus Sammer - Hotel Garni
beschreibung: The Landhaus Sammer is a traditional inn in Tannheim, Tirol. It is situated in a picturesque location, surrounded by the Alps of the Tannheimer Täler. The surroundings offer ideal conditions for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. The amenities of the Hotel Garni include comfortable rooms with alpine charm and a wellness area. The in-house restaurant serves regional specialties. The atmosphere is family-like and warm, enhanced by the personal attention of the hosts. The target group is primarily nature lovers and active holidaymakers seeking relaxation in the mountains.
